job.title: Security Engineer I, Security Incident Response Team (SIRT)
job.pay_full: $136,000 – $184,000 a year base salary (Arlington, VA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon's Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), part of its Information Security organization, responds to security events, analyses threats such as malware and intrusion attempts, and protects highly sensitive data. Its engineers work hands-on with detection systems and vulnerability analysis tools, gather and analyse event data and run root-cause analysis, drawing on forensics, malware analysis, network and application security, threat hunting and threat intelligence.
duties: Respond to security incidents and coordinate the response across multiple Amazon teams
Provide security engineering support during customer-facing incidents and help prevent repeats
Help develop pragmatic solutions that meet business needs at an acceptable level of risk
Identify and recommend ways to improve or expand Amazon's incident response capabilities
Work alongside and mentor Information Security engineers to reduce and quickly address risk
Assess how new security trends, advisories and research affect Amazon and coordinate the response
Keep skills current with the changing threat landscape
Take part in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation
needs: 2+ years of experience with web protocols, common security attacks and remediation (non-internship)
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field
Knowledge of system security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques, including penetration testing and exploit development or equivalent
Experience solving basic problems by writing code or scripts with some assistance
nice: Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
details.benefits: Base salary $136,000 – $184,000 a year (Arlington, VA). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon Security encourages candidates to apply even if they don't meet every listed qualification
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
